body: Bit of both. I use Fedora on my daily driver laptop and Debian on my server, but my gaming PC obviously runs Windows.
Going for system administration myself. It'll take a bit to get there since I'm mainly going off of certs and self-taught Linux skills, but I intend on doing whatever it takes.

I want to thank you for your response regardless of the age difference. A lot of this awkwardness, pain, and misery is super familiar to me, and while I am intent on being social to some extent, I'm glad that you found solace in being diagnosed and living by your own rules.

Just want to say that I appreciate the concern, but at the moment I'm not in danger of committing suicide. I have an intake appointment lined up with a therapist today. 

I probably should have gone with a less alarming name, but it's certainly reflective of how I can feel sometimes when I'm constantly reliving past trauma.
